seed: THE CLAIM (the user, 2026-10-17: "i open an image and the top left dropdown says 'video'... when you open a video, you shouldn't see the dropdown"): the mode chip only offers what fits what is open. A recording's window has no chip at all, because a document with time has one setup, and a mode key does nothing to it. A picture opened after it starts in Image, and its list offers Image, Icon and Design in that order, with no Video row. Picking Design on the picture changes that window only: opening the recording again shows no chip, and the picture after it starts in Image again. At Next defaults, no switch changed.

steps.note: a recording, in Edit: the title bar has no mode chip beside the traffic lights, because a video has one setup and a list of one is not a choice
a picture opened next starts in Image, whatever the recording's window was set up for
the list a picture is offered: Image, Icon, Design, then Show Everything under the line. No Video row
Control 2 is Icon now: Control 1 Image, Control 2 Icon, Control 3 Design, the list's order
the recording again: still no chip, and nothing Icon folds reaches it
a second picture starts in Image again
